faq.title: Frequently asked questions

items.q: Is there a free trial, and do I need a credit card?
items.a: You can try it free for 14 days — no credit card required for the trial.

items.q: How long does it take to connect my store?
items.a: Most integrations connect in 2-3 minutes with your API key, no code required.
All data is encrypted at rest and isolated per account; backups are taken regularly.
Monthly plans have no commitment — cancel whenever you like. Annual plans come with an extra discount.
We support Shopify, Trendyol, Amazon, Etsy, eBay, Hepsiburada, AliExpress and more.

items.q: Is a custom integration or API possible?
items.a: Growth plans and above include REST API and webhook support.

faq.ctaSubtitle: Try it free for 14 days — we'll help answer your questions as you go.

trust.title: Built on infrastructure you can trust
trust.subtitle: Security isn't a checkbox here — it's how the product is built.

dataIsolation.title: Team-level data isolation
dataIsolation.description: Every team's data is isolated at the database level with row-level security — no cross-tenant access is possible.

auditTrail.title: Full audit trail
auditTrail.description: Every rule change and store action is logged and visible in your workspace, not just kept internally.

encryptedCredentials.title: Encrypted store credentials
encryptedCredentials.description: API keys and tokens for every connected marketplace are encrypted at rest, never stored in plain text.

rateLimiting.title: Rate limiting & bot protection
rateLimiting.description: Auth and public endpoints are protected against abuse with rate limiting and Cloudflare Turnstile.

errorTracking.title: Proactive error tracking
errorTracking.description: Sentry monitors both the dashboard and sync workers, so failures surface before they cost you a stockout.

billing.title: PCI-compliant billing
billing.description: Payments run through Paddle as Merchant of Record — your card details never touch our servers.

about.title: About StockAlert
about.subtitle: Built by Lavanchor for e-commerce sellers who can't afford to find out about a stockout from a customer.
about.body: StockAlert connects to the marketplaces you already sell on and watches inventory levels around the clock, so low-stock and out-of-stock situations reach your team before they reach your customers. It's built as a focused, single-purpose tool rather than a bolt-on feature of a larger platform — inventory alerting is the whole product.
